name: Task 5: Validity Dimension - Regex Matching & Domain Set Constraints
description:
[SILVER LAYER] [DIMENSION: Validity] [ACTION: QUARANTINE]
Verifies format regex (Emirates ID), allowed status values, and academic year range:
- Invalid formats (e.g. STU005 'INVALID_EID_FORMAT_999') are isolated with STU_DQ_02 error tag.
- Invalid domain values (e.g. STU013 'UNKNOWN_GENDER', ENR017 'INVALID_STATUS') are quarantined.
